name: Priest
overview: Scripture reveals the role of priests as mediators who approach the Lord with sanctity and consecration, as seen in the call for Israel to be a 'kingdom of priests' (Exodus 19:6) and the warning for priests to sanctify themselves lest the Lord break forth upon them (Exodus 19:22, 19:24). The priestly office is exemplified by Melchizedek, who was both king and priest of the Most High God, demonstrating the sacredness of the priestly function even before the Mosaic Law (Genesis 14:18). Priests are entrusted with sacred duties such as setting the showbread before God (Exodus 25:30), highlighting their role in worship and maintaining holiness within the community.
